whenToUse: Split views that set a sidebar beside content or a header over a body, sized by dragging the divider
Editor and IDE style workspaces of 3 or more panes, in one row or nested across both directions
Layouts that read live pane sizes back into app state, such as a percentage readout

whenNotToUse.when: A complete product layout with navigation, header and content area already in place
Task bars stretched along a timeline to change their start and end dates
Table rows and columns that users reorder by hand or widen at the header edge

agentNotes: A number in `defaultSize` or `minSize` is read as pixels, not percent; pass a string such as 30% when a panel should take a share of the group
`orientation` vertical stacks the panels with horizontal dividers between them and horizontal sets them side by side; the v4 group has no direction prop
react-resizable-panels needs every Panel and Separator to be a direct DOM child of its Group, so never wrap a `ResizablePanel` or `ResizableHandle` in a div
